2026 Outreach GrantScoring ballot

Score the 2026 Outreach Grant applications

233 applications across 10 funding pools. Six criteria, 1 to 5 points each, 30 points possible, plus your funding recommendation.

You score each application question as you read it. Your scores save as you go on this device and stay private to you; the chair sees them only when you send your ballot. If you switch computers or browsers, download your ballot first and load it back in here.

Score independently. Do not compare notes with other scorers, and do not communicate with applicants, county chairs, officers, DEC members, or caucus leadership during the review window. Recuse where you have a conflict. The control at the bottom of each application hides it and removes it from your ballot. It does not count against the applicant. 18.00 of 30 is the funding floor. Below it an application is not funded even if money remains in its pool.
